abstracts.abstract: To amend sections 4507.11, 4508.02, 4511.01, 4511.20, 4511.514, 4511.522, and 4511.54 and to enact sections 4503.184 and 4508.081 of the Revised Code to revise the law regarding electric bicycles, low-speed micromobility devices, and electric personal assistive mobility devices.
